title: Forward drift inputs through deploy_nonprod_vm.sh driver calls

reproduction.incident_description: In deployment run 35206610883, capture passed following PR #5886, sealing the baseline manifest with image bundle source_sha equal to observed_live_bff_sha (dc15751a9b20f8bc0931529d68af8898e691c898). However, during deploy_nonprod_vm.sh, ssh_bash and run_dev_artifact_driver only forwarded the 8 fixed identity fields, omitting PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_BASELINE_SOURCE and PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA. On the VM, the driver could not resolve drift recovery source (_drift_recovery_source returned None) and expected bundle source_sha to equal previous_backend_sha. During seal-candidate, validate_images failed at dev_release_artifacts.py:324 with 'bundle schema/source mismatch' (exit 75). In the ensuing rollback, DEV_CANDIDATE_RECEIPT_ACKED was false, triggering unchanged baseline verification which failed with the exact same mismatch.

root_cause.ssh_bash_omitted_drift_forwarding: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh:ssh_bash() built command_prefix by iterating only 15 fixed artifact variables, omitting PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_BASELINE_SOURCE and PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA so they were absent from the remote VM session.
root_cause.run_dev_artifact_driver_omitted_drift_fo: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh:run_dev_artifact_driver() only passed 8 identity fields to dev_release_artifact_driver.py, omitting --baseline-source and --observed-live-bff-sha across seal-candidate, verify, and restore.

fix_description.deploy_nonprod_vm_sh: Forwarded PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_BASELINE_SOURCE and PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA in ssh_bash command_prefix; validated 40-hex format for observed_live_bff_sha when baseline_source ends with +live_bff_drift_recovery in both validate_artifact_restore_request and run_dev_artifact_driver; forwarded --baseline-source and --observed-live-bff-sha in run_dev_artifact_driver to dev_release_artifact_driver.py; documented drift variables in environment overrides help.
fix_description.test_coverage: In test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py, added test_deploy_nonprod_vm_includes_drift_artifact_environment_variables, test_actual_ssh_command_forwards_drift_metadata, test_all_driver_call_points_forward_drift_inputs testing all 5 call sites (seal-candidate, rollback-verify, rollback-restore, external-verify, external-restore), test_driver_call_omits_drift_flags_when_drift_absent, test_run_dev_artifact_driver_rejects_invalid_observed_drift_sha, test_validate_artifact_restore_request_rejects_invalid_observed_drift_sha, and test_drifted_fixture_full_chain_reproduces_run_35206610883_without_forwarding_and_succeeds_with_forwarding exercising the full chain with the same drifted fixture.

driver_call_points.context: candidate build post-up seal before mutation receipt ack
post-up failure before candidate receipt ack; verifies unchanged prior baseline
post-up failure after candidate receipt ack; restores sealed prior artifact images
external operator/pipeline invocation verifying prior baseline state
external operator/pipeline invocation restoring prior baseline state

invariants_enforced.drift_identity_forwarded: Drift inputs from the runner workflow are preserved across SSH and handed off to every driver call point.
invariants_enforced.eight_field_identity_preserved: The 8-field identity contract (candidate_id, run_id, attempt, controller_sha, candidate_backend_sha, candidate_frontend_sha, previous_backend_sha, previous_frontend_sha) remains the immutable foundation.
invariants_enforced.fail_closed_validation: Non-40-hex or malformed observed live BFF SHA fails closed before driver execution.
invariants_enforced.isolation: Pure source and isolated test scope only; no hosted deployments, redeploys, or capital changes performed.
